What skills and experience we're looking for
Thank you for your interest in joining our College as a Cleaning Assistant.
Our Cleaning Team plays a vital role in creating a safe, welcoming and inspiring environment for our students, staff and visitors. Every day, the work of our cleaning colleagues helps ensure that the College remains a place where people can learn, work and thrive.
We are looking for reliable, hardworking individuals who take pride in their work and enjoy being part of a supportive team. Whether you already have cleaning experience or are looking to develop new skills, we would love to hear from you.
Our Cleaning Team is made up of 15 dedicated colleagues who work across morning and afternoon shifts to maintain the high standards of cleanliness that our College community expects.
Working closely with the Cleaning Supervisor and Estates Team, you'll be part of a friendly team where collaboration, mutual support and a strong work ethic are highly valued. We recognise that every member of staff contributes to the College's success, and our cleaning colleagues are a valued and respected part of that achievement.
As a Cleaning Assistant, you will help provide a clean, safe and welcoming environment for everyone who studies, works and visits the College.
Working as part of a supportive team, you will carry out a range of cleaning duties across the campus to ensure our facilities remain well-presented and maintained to a high standard.
Your contribution will directly support the learning experience of our students and the wellbeing of the wider College community.
Training will be provided in the use of specialist cleaning equipment where necessary.
Areas will be allocated by the Cleaning Supervisor or Estates Team according to College priorities.
Washing and storing crockery where required
Operating cleaning equipment and machinery following appropriate training
Reporting any maintenance issues, hazards or concerns identified during your work
Supporting colleagues to maintain high standards across the College
Undertaking other duties appropriate to the role as reasonably required
The College is committed to providing a safe working environment for all staff, students and visitors.
Follow all health and safety procedures and guidance
Use cleaning equipment safely and responsibly
Report accidents, incidents, defects or hazards promptly
Take a proactive approach to maintaining a safe environment for yourself and others
Is willing to be flexible and support colleagues when needed
Understands the importance of delivering consistently high standards
The College is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of young people and expects all staff to share this commitment.
Understand and follow the College's safeguarding procedures
Report any concerns regarding the welfare of students without delay
Attend safeguarding training relevant to their role
The post holder must also work in accordance with the College's:
Vision, values and behavioural expectations
We would particularly welcome applications from candidates who can demonstrate:
Excellent reliability, attendance and timekeeping
The ability to work with minimal supervision
Flexibility and willingness to support the needs of the College
A commitment to maintaining high standards
Previous cleaning experience in a commercial, educational or similar environment
Experience using cleaning equipment or machinery (training will be provided)
Closing date: Midday, Monday 12th October 2026
As a Cleaning Assistant, you will be joining a supportive team where your contribution is valued and recognised. You will play an important part in creating a clean, safe and welcoming environment that helps students achieve their potential and staff perform at their best.
A friendly and collaborative working environment
The opportunity to contribute to a successful and thriving College community
An enhanced DBS check is required for this post and the successful applicant will either need to apply for a DBS or give the Trust consent to check their status if they are registered with the Update Service.
An online search will be undertaken for shortlisted candidates as part of the recruitment process on information available in the public domain. Candidates should disclose anything that may be relevant in line with KCSIE. This search does not form part of the shortlisting process and candidates will have the chance to discuss any issues of concern at interview.
